title: Farming in boastful talk
literal_meaning: The boaster’s cultivation of twelve bati of land.
explanation: Someone boasts of cultivating a large area without the knowledge or ability to do it. The grand claim of twelve bati of land exposes the gap between talk and competence.
meaning_odia: ବାରବାଟି ଅର୍ଥ ବାର ବାଟି ଜମି। ଚାଷ ବିଷୟରେ ଜ୍ଞାନ ବା ଦକ୍ଷତା ନଥାଇ ଏତେ ଜମି ଚାଷ କରିବାର ବଡ଼ କଥା କହିବାକୁ ଏହି ରୂଢ଼ି ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ କରେ। କଥାର ବଡ଼ପଣ ପଛରେ କାମ କରିବାର ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ ଅଛି କି ନାହିଁ, ତାହା ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ।
usage_example: Someone promises a complex project without knowing its basic requirements. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: ବାଟି is a land measure here; twelve bati gives the boast its large scale.
